cases.summary: Form is used for registration and re-registration
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open Client Registration. 2. Open Re-identification if available.
cases.expected: The KYC form in this annex applies to registration and re-registration.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-001; This Form is For Registration and Re-Registration

cases.summary: National ID is offered and OCR is mandatory
cases.input: 1. Select National ID. 2. Attempt to continue without OCR.
cases.expected: National ID is available. OCR is mandatory.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-002; Type of ID — National ID

cases.summary: CEDEAO ID is offered and OCR is optional
cases.input: 1. Select CEDEAO / CEDAO. 2. Continue with OCR skipped if the UI allows.
cases.expected: CEDEAO ID is available. OCR is optional.

cases.summary: Foreign passport is 8 digits and characters; OCR mandatory
cases.input: 1. Select Passeport. 2. Enter an ID that is not 8 alphanumeric. 3. Scan with OCR.
cases.expected: Passport is allowed except national. Length is 8 digits and character long. OCR is mandatory.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-004; Passeport — except national, 8 digits and character long

cases.summary: Senegalese passport uses NIN; OCR mandatory
cases.expected: ID is NIN. OCR is mandatory.

cases.summary: Refugee card is 11 digits and characters; OCR optional
cases.input: 1. Select Refugee card. 2. Enter a value that is not 11 alphanumeric.
cases.expected: Refugee card is available. Length is 11 digits and character long. OCR is optional.

cases.summary: Customer picture is not required on this annex
cases.input: 1. Look for a mandatory customer picture capture on the form defined by this annex.
cases.expected: Picture of client is No / NA. Do not treat SAA-910 Customer Photo as this annex's rule when they disagree; record the observed form.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-007; Customer identification — Picture of client | No

cases.summary: Name, last name, date of birth, address, ID number are mandatory with OCR YES
cases.input: 1. Observe Name, Last name, Date of birth, Address, ID number. 2. Attempt to clear each.
cases.expected: Those fields are mandatory. OCR column is YES.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-009, REQ-011, REQ-013, REQ-014; KYC Form mandatory OCR YES fields

cases.summary: Gender is present and not mandatory
cases.expected: Gender is Yes, Not Mandatory. OCR optional.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-010; Gender | Yes, Not Mandatory

cases.summary: Country is only for passport and OCR YES
cases.preconditions: Passport selected, then National ID selected
cases.input: 1. Observe Country on passport. 2. Observe Country on National ID.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-012; Country | Only for passport

cases.summary: Address captures street, region, préfecture, commune, canton, city
cases.expected: Address (street, region, préfecture, commune, canton, city) is mandatory.
cases.traceability: SAA-917; REQ-013; Adress (street, region, préfecture, commune, canton, city)
